name: Battlefield of Eternity
theme: Defeat the enemy Immortal in the center arena while defending your own to empower a massive lane push.

mechanic.title: The Duel of the Immortals
mechanic.description: Two Immortals spawn in the center arena (first warning at 2:30, spawns at 3:00; 2:15 cooldown after a winning Immortal dies). At 50% health, they swap positions and reset their AoE stun abilities. Once one Immortal is defeated, the surviving Immortal regenerates health, gains shields equal to its remaining HP percentage, and pushes the enemy's strongest lane—using ranged attacks until its shields are broken before switching to melee.

camps.name: Fallen Shaman / Bruiser Camps (2 Camps)
camps.notes: Located in the top-mid and bottom-mid alcoves. The Fallen Shaman continuously summons demonic hounds until killed, making these camps exceptionally strong at pushing lanes if ignored.

camps.name: Khazra / Impaler Camps (2 Camps)
camps.notes: Located near top-left/top-right and bottom-left/bottom-right. Ranged spear-throwers that provide steady siege damage; easy to clear right before Immortal phases.

strategy: Battlefield of Eternity is a two-lane battleground with no Boss camp where single-target sustained DPS (such as Valla, Greymane, Artanis, or Hanzo) heavily dictates objective control. Time your Fallen Shaman camps right before the 3:00 Immortal spawn to force the enemy team into defending lane pressure or losing structures. If your team has superior Immortal burn speed, race down the enemy Immortal while using poke heroes to interrupt defenders; if you have stronger teamfight engage, defend your own Immortal and punish enemies caught in its AoE stun rings.
